result.excerpt:
FlightAware's AeroAPI comes in **three tiers — Personal, Standard, Premium** — and it's priced **per query** (per "result set"), not as a flat subscription. The tiers differ mainly in what you're licensed to do with the data, the monthly minimum, the rate limit and the support level; the per-call price list is the same for everyone.

## The three plans

| | **Personal** | **Standard** | **Premium** |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Purpose** | Personal or academic use only | Business and B2C use | Business, B2C **and all B2B** commercial use |
| **Included APIs** | Current flight status and tracks; static maps and imagery | Everything in Personal **plus** flight alerting and historical flight data | Everything in Standard **plus** Foresight predictions and Aireon space-based ADS-B* |
| **Monthly minimum** | **None** — usage fees only, with up to **$5 free per month** ($10 free for ADS-B feeders) | **$100/month** (subject to minimum) | **$1,000/month** (subject to minimum) |
| **Result-set rate limit** | 10 result sets/minute | 5 result sets/second | 100 result sets/second |
| **Historical result sets** | Not included | 500,000/month | 500,000/month |
| **Volume discounting** | No | Yes | Yes |
| **Licensed use** | Storage/distribution of derivative works for personal or academic purposes | Also internal business use and B2C commercialisation | Also B2B commercialisation |
| **Support** | — | Email support | Email **and phone** support; invoicing available; 99.5% uptime guarantee |

\* Foresight and Aireon require contacting FlightAware to enable, and some use restrictions apply. Alerts are excluded from Personal. Every plan includes internal personal use and academic use.
